nodes.label: Merchant-Tuned-as-Platform-Default Pattern
nodes.summary: When a merchant's per-store config is iterated to perfection, the generic portion (sizes, spacing) is extracted and baked as the platform default so every future tenant inherits a calibrated baseline without manual re-tuning.

nodes.label: Generic vs Brand-Specific Split Rule
nodes.summary: Platform defaults may only absorb geometry (fontSize, fontWeight, padding, borderRadius, letterSpacing, layout structure); brand-specific values (fontFamily, color references, chip backgroundColor, textDecorationColor) stay in the merchant's Store.typography JSON.

nodes.label: Neon Snapshot SQL Pull Recipe
nodes.summary: Pull a merchant's live config via `SELECT typography, layout_settings, theme, settings FROM stores WHERE slug = '...'`. For historical state, point a prod-<sha> Neon snapshot branch at the SQL editor and diff the two JSONs.

nodes.label: Pack-Styles Migration Cascade (5-Step)
nodes.summary: When baking a new size default, all 5 layers must be updated in order: (1) pack-styles.ts per theme, (2) SectionHeading.tsx hardcoded classes, (3) component-level hardcoded sizes (e.g. ProductsFilterSidebar), (4) THEME_DEFAULT_SIZES table in admin typography page, (5) design.md typography size table. Missing any step causes storefront/admin badge drift.

nodes.label: Wady Aljuz Typography → Platform Default (2026-05-16)
nodes.summary: Six fontSize overrides pulled from Wady Aljuz (sectionTitle 22px, sectionSeeAll/sectionSubtitle 20px, productName 18.5px→18, filters/header 18px) baked into all 5 themes via pack-styles.ts. Cairo font and brand color refs were NOT baked — stayed merchant-specific.

nodes.label: THEME_DEFAULT_SIZES Must Stay in Sync
nodes.summary: The THEME_DEFAULT_SIZES constant in apps/admin typography page drives the gray 'theme default' badge in the admin UI. If pack-styles.ts is updated but THEME_DEFAULT_SIZES is not, the badge lies about what actually renders on the storefront.

nodes.label: Multi-Theme Cascade Discipline
nodes.summary: Size defaults must be applied to all 5 Ebda Store themes in pack-styles.ts simultaneously. Cascading to only one theme silently introduces cross-theme size drift that is hard to detect without comparing storefronts side by side.

nodes.label: Brand Font Must Not Become Platform Default
nodes.summary: fontFamily (e.g. Cairo used by Wady Aljuz) is never baked as a platform default — doing so locks every new merchant into one brand's typeface. It belongs in Store.typography and exposed via the multi-zone quick presets for merchants who want the same look.

nodes.label: Chip Shape vs Color Separation Anti-Pattern
nodes.summary: Baking chip padding+radius+backgroundColor together as a platform default mixes geometry (platform-safe) with brand color (merchant-specific). Correct approach: bake shape geometry as default, expose the color as a preset option via multi-zone quick presets.

nodes.label: design.md as Living Platform Typography Spec
nodes.summary: design.md at the repo root contains the authoritative typography size table. Every bake-in of merchant-validated sizes must update this file so it remains the single source of truth for designers and future Claude sessions.
